Definition: from G2110; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good deed done.
BiblicalUsage: euergesía means benefit, good deed done. In Acts 4:9, the text says "If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man."
TheologicalSignificance: I take euergesía as it stands: benefit, good deed done.
RelatedEvents: Peter and John Before the Sanhedrin
